👋 Hey there! Welcome to Atria Institute of Technology's CampusBuddy!

I can help you with:
• 🕗 College timings & schedule
• 🏢 Department & floor info
• 🍽️ Canteen details
• 💻 Labs & classrooms
• 🎓 Clubs & activities
• 📝 Complaints & more!

What do you need?

Hello! CampusBuddy here — your guide to Atria Institute of Technology. 🎓

Ask me anything about campus life!
Hi! Ready to help you navigate Atria campus. What's on your mind? 🚀

🏫 Our college is **Atria Institute of Technology (AIT)**

A prestigious engineering institution offering undergraduate and postgraduate programs in various disciplines.

📍 Departments spread across 5 floors with modern labs, seminar halls, quadrangle, ground & more! ✅

🕗 Atria College Timings

• Regular Days: 8:30 AM – 3:30 PM
• Fee Days / Special Days: Up to 4:30 PM or 5:30 PM
• Lab Days: May end at 12:45 PM (half day schedule)

📌 Timings may vary based on your timetable.
Always check with your class coordinator for the day's schedule. ✅

🔒 Saturday: Holiday

🎉 Yes! Saturday is a holiday at Atria Institute of Technology.

College operates Monday to Friday only.

• Regular hours: 8:30 AM – 3:30 PM (Mon–Fri)
• Enjoy your weekend! 😄 ✅

🏢 Atria Institute of Technology — Floor Guide

• 🔌 1st Floor: ECE (Electronics & Communication Engineering)
• 2nd Floor: Common areas / Admin
• 💻 3rd Floor: CSE (Computer Science Engineering)
• 📊 4th Floor: ISE (Information Science Engineering)
• 5th Floor: Additional departments / Facilities

Total: 5 Floors ✅

Need directions to a specific department? Just ask!

🔌 ECE Department — Electronics & Communication Engineering

• Location: 1st Floor
• Labs: Electronics lab, Communication lab, and more
• Weekly Labs: 2-hour sessions, 3 times a week

For faculty or room details, check with your ECE department coordinator. ✅

💻 CSE Department — Computer Science Engineering

• Location: 3rd Floor
• Labs: Programming lab, Data structures lab, Networks lab & more
• Weekly Labs: 2-hour sessions, 3 times a week

For faculty or room details, check with your CSE department coordinator. ✅

📊 ISE Department — Information Science Engineering

• Location: 4th Floor
• Labs: Software lab, Database lab, AI/ML lab & more
• Weekly Labs: 2-hour sessions, 3 times a week

For faculty or room details, check with your ISE department coordinator. ✅

🔬 Lab Schedule at Atria

• Duration: 2 hours per session
• Frequency: 3 lab sessions per week
• Type: Different labs each session (rotating subjects)

📌 Lab Locations by Department:
• ECE Labs: 1st Floor
• CSE Labs: 3rd Floor
• ISE Labs: 4th Floor

Check your personal timetable for your specific lab days and timings. ✅

⚠️ Bring your lab record and wear formal shoes!

🍽️ Atria Canteen Info

• Location: Ground Floor area
• Opens: 10:30 AM (after first session)
• Available: Snacks, meals, juices, tea & coffee

📌 Canteen Tips:
• Busiest during 10:30 AM break — go early!
• Lunch available around 1:00 PM onwards
• UPI & cash accepted

⚠️ Canteen is closed on Saturdays (college holiday). ✅

🅿️ Parking at Atria

• Parking Lot: Available on campus premises
• For: Two-wheelers and four-wheelers
• Location: Ground level / campus entrance area

📌 Tips:
• Park in designated areas only
• Keep your vehicle RC and college ID handy
• Avoid blocking emergency access lanes ✅

⚽ Campus Ground at Atria

• A spacious ground available for sports and outdoor activities
• Used for: Cricket, Football, Athletics & other sports
• Also used for: Cultural events, college fests & gatherings

📌 For sports equipment or ground booking, contact the Physical Education department. ✅

🎭 Cultural Events at Atria

• Venue: College Ground (main large events)
• Type: Cultural programs, fests, performances, competitions
• Frequency: Not frequent — special occasions only

📌 Watch out for:
• Annual Cultural Fest
• Department-specific events
• National & special day celebrations

Announcements are made via notice boards and class coordinators. Keep an eye out! 🎉 ✅

🎤 Seminar Halls at Atria

• Multiple seminar halls available across departments
• Used for: Guest lectures, seminars, project presentations, workshops
• Equipped with: Projector, mic system, seating arrangement

📌 To book a seminar hall:
• Contact your department coordinator
• Or raise a request through the Admin Office ✅

🌿 Quadrangle at Atria

• A open common area within the campus
• Used for: Relaxing between classes, informal gatherings, small events
• A great spot to hang out with friends! 😊

📌 Keep the quadrangle clean and respect shared spaces. ✅

📝 How to Register a Complaint at Atria

Step 1: Log in to the ERP Portal
Step 2: Go to 'Grievance Cell' section
Step 3: Fill in your complaint clearly with details
Step 4: Submit — note your reference number

📌 Alternatively:
• Visit the Student Affairs Office directly
• Speak to your class coordinator or HOD
• Email the grievance cell

All complaints are reviewed within 3–5 working days. ✅

📅 Holiday Info at Atria

• Saturday: Weekly holiday (no college) 🎉
• Sunday: Holiday

📌 Other holidays:
• National Holidays (Republic Day, Independence Day, Gandhi Jayanti)
• Festival Holidays (Pongal, Diwali, Eid, Christmas etc.)
• College-specific holidays announced via notice board

Always check with your class coordinator or notice board for updated holiday list. ✅

💡 Coding Club at Atria

• Focus: DSA, Web Development, Competitive Programming, Hackathons
• Meetings: Scheduled on weekdays (check notice board for current timing)
• Venue: CSE/ISE Lab floors (3rd or 4th floor)
• How to Join: Contact club coordinator or check department notice board

🏆 Activities: Internal hackathons, coding contests, project showcases

Open to all branches and years! ✅

🎯 Student Clubs at Atria Institute of Technology

💻 Coding Club — Programming & Tech
🤖 Robotics Club — Hardware & AI projects
🎵 Music Club — Vocals & instruments
🎨 Art & Design Club — Creative arts
📸 Photography Club — Campus photography
📢 NSS — National Social Service
🏆 Sports Club — Cricket, Football & Athletics

📌 For joining any club:
• Check your department notice board
• Contact Student Affairs office ✅

📚 Library at Atria

• Location: Within the campus building
• Timings: 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM (Mon–Fri)
• Collection: Technical books, reference materials, journals
• Borrowing: Student ID required

📌 e-Resources also available — check with librarian for digital library access. ✅

📶 Campus Wi-Fi at Atria

• Available across campus floors
• Login: Use your college credentials

⚠️ Wi-Fi issues?
• Contact the IT department
• Or visit the computer lab on your floor for assistance ✅

📋 Exam Info at Atria

• CIE (Internal): Announced by faculty — check class group/notice board
• SEE (Semester End Exam): Schedule published 2 weeks prior on ERP Portal
• Hall Tickets: Available on ERP Portal 1 week before exam
• Results: Published within 3–4 weeks after exam

📌 For exam-related issues, contact the Exam Cell at the Admin Office. ✅

💳 Fee Payment at Atria

• Portal: ERP → 'Fee Payment' section
• Modes: UPI, Net Banking, Debit/Credit Card or Cash at Accounts Office
• Fee Days: College may extend till 4:30 PM or 5:30 PM on fee collection days
• Receipt: Auto-generated on ERP after payment

⚠️ Pay before due date to avoid late fine. Check ERP for current due dates. ✅

📊 Attendance at Atria

• Minimum Required: 75% to sit for SEE (Semester End Exam)
• Check: ERP Portal → 'My Attendance'
• Updates: Reflected within 24 hours of class
• Shortage Warning: Issued if attendance falls below 65%

📌 Lab attendance is also counted — don't skip labs!

For medical leave, submit a letter to your class coordinator within 3 days. ✅

📆 Timetable at Atria

• Check: ERP Portal → 'My Timetable'
• Includes: Lecture hours + Lab sessions (2 hrs, 3 times/week)
• Timing varies: Regular days end 3:30 PM, some days 4:30 or 5:30 PM

📌 Your timetable is specific to your section and semester.
Always carry a copy or screenshot for reference! ✅

💪 You've got this, Atrian!

"Success is not final, failure is not fatal — it is the courage to continue that counts."
— Winston Churchill

Every great engineer started exactly where you are. Keep pushing! 🚀

🌟 Hey, tough days are part of the journey!

The fact that you showed up to college today already makes you ahead. Believe in your process! 💛

Atria is giving you the platform — you bring the effort! 🎓

🔥 College is hard — but so are you!

Take a short break, grab something from the canteen, breathe, and come back stronger.

You're building your future at Atria — one lecture at a time! 💪

😄 Why do CSE students prefer dark mode?

Because light attracts bugs! 🐛

😂 An Atria professor asked: 'Will this be on the exam?'
Student: 'Will attendance be on the exam too?' 💀

🤣 Why did the ISE student bring a ladder to college?

Because they heard the course was on a higher level! 😂
😊 You're welcome! Happy to help anytime. Go Atrians! 🎓
Glad I could help! Come back whenever you need campus info. All the best! 🌟
No problem at all! That's what CampusBuddy is here for. 🤝
👋 Goodbye! Have a productive day at Atria! 🎓
See you later! Come back anytime you need help. 🚀
Take care! All the best with your studies at Atria! 💪
